fixes.name: corrections log v2 — full 7d refused_as_completed rows
fixes.sql: SELECT spawn_id, parent_agent_id, created_at, status AS ledger_status, 'refused_as_completed' AS true_label FROM agent.subagent_spawns WHERE created_at > (EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()))::bigint - 604800 AND md5(final_response)='b4aefd29108f232f9c0d5a4b030215c1' ORDER BY spawn_id

fixes.name: true success rate — genuine vs refused_as_completed vs other
fixes.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN md5(final_response)='b4aefd29108f232f9c0d5a4b030215c1' THEN 'refused_as_completed' WHEN length(final_response) > 200 THEN 'genuine' ELSE 'other' END AS cls, count(*) FROM agent.subagent_spawns WHERE created_at > (EXTRACT(epoch FROM now()))::bigint - 604800 GROUP BY 1
